description:
Add a FilterItem sub-component to the todo example to demonstrate the correct abstraction boundary for per-item isolation.

## Motivation

Whole-loop memoization (flm-o58.3) means if filters changes, all handlers are recomputed. For the filter bar with 3 stable items this is fine. For larger or more dynamic lists, per-item isolation requires a sub-component — each gets its own fiber and its own {:t, N} slot layout.

## Change

Extract filter item rendering from FilterBar into a defcomponent FilterItem that receives value, label, is_active, and on_click as props. FilterBar renders <FilterItem /> for each item.

This demonstrates:
- Sub-component as the right abstraction for per-item stability
- <FilterBar /> and <FilterItem /> JSX syntax in the same template
- Child component rendering in a comprehension

## Acceptance

- Filter bar renders and functions identically to before
- Each FilterItem is a separate Filament component with its own fiber
- Clicking filter buttons still changes active state correctly
title: flm-o58.4: Demonstrate per-item isolation via FilterItem sub-component
